memory_lookup_ms: sub-ms to few-ms — postings query + bounded rebind; loaded from {state}/memory
rebind_cost: per symbol: manifest load (once) + FileAnalysis read + one byte-slice sha256 per facet; lazy per-path
live_derivation: incremental; derives only sessions with new tail events; bounded by checkpoint cadence
p95_derivation_lag: bounded by checkpoint_dirty_updates/checkpoint_interval_s; measured via derived_lag_events (events pending), not a separate timer in V1
